newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy April CPI seen at 1.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy April CPI seen at 1.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian April consumer price inflation is seen at 0.2 percent month-on-month and 1.8 percent year-on-year, according to analysts' estimates after preliminary data from six sample Italian cities on Monday.
March CPI stood at 0.1 percent and 2.2 percent respectively.
Economists in a Reuter survey had forecast on average an April month-on-month rate of 0.2 percent and a year-on-year rate of 1.8 percent.
"This is a good number and we can't exlude a fall even to 1.7 per cent for April," one analyst said.
Milan, Turin, Trieste, Bari, Venice and Naples announced their preliminary data on Monday.
Genoa, Bologna, Florence, Perugia and Palermo will announce their figures on Tuesday.
Final national April CPI data will be published on May 6.
